card???? Is it only the Vampire doing the burning or can another
vampire play this card??? In the latter case who recieves the blood???

played in someone elses turn??

2) This is kind of a dumb question but I haven't been able to locate the

retainer takes the damage??

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Bastet <damc...@mtholyoke.edu> writes:
>1) Concerning the card Soul Stealing-- Who is eligible to play this
> card???? Is it only the Vampire doing the burning or can another
> vampire play this card??? In the latter case who recieves the blood???
> The wording implies that the burning vampire does. Also can it be
> played in someone elses turn??

Action Modifiers can only be played by the acting minion, unless otherwise
stated on card text.
Action modifiers can only be played on your own turn (even if you take an
action during someone else's turn).

>2) This is kind of a dumb question but I haven't been able to locate the
> rules concerning it. When recieveing ranged damage, who decides if a
> retainer takes the damage??

The damage dealer decides. (Retainers can only be targetted when the
round is at long range).

>L. Scott Johnson (sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu) wrote:
>: >2) This is kind of a dumb question but I haven't been able to locate the
>: > rules concerning it. When recieveing ranged damage, who decides if a
>: > retainer takes the damage??
>:
>: The damage dealer decides. (Retainers can only be targetted when the
>: round is at long range).

>Is this a revision? I thought that the damage had to be ranged, not that
>the combat had to be at long and the damage ranged. In other words, can't
>I throw a sewer lid at a faithful retainer even though her boss is clawing
>at my face?

Well, you can't throw a sewer lid at close range to begin with (card text
on Sewer Lid prevents this).

But, yes, it is a change in the way things are handled (from Jyhad to VtES).

You can't shoot (or throw a gate, or have bats attack) a retainer whose
employer is standing in your face. (Idea being that you're too concerned
with HTH combat that you can't properly target the retainer).
